question: What is my open pipeline by stage this quarter?
Which of my deals mention a competitor and close this quarter?
Show my top 5 deals by ACV times close probability.
Which accounts have usage down more than 15% in the last 30 days and an open opportunity?
What are the open next steps from my last calls?
What is my quota attainment and pipeline coverage this quarter?
What are my top 5 open next best actions by priority?
Which of my accounts have the most whitespace products?
How many open leads are routed to each segment, and what is their average fit score?
How does customer sentiment break down across my calls?

content:
Fleetwise Revenue Copilot answers questions about a seller's own pipeline, accounts, sales calls, AI deal scores and next best actions.
Row-level security: every v_* view is already scoped to the caller. "my", "I", "me" and "our" mean the caller's persona (mapped through demo_identity_map; a seller sees their own book, a manager their team). The views have already applied that scope, so NEVER add a filter on owner_name, owner_id or any person's name for "my" questions; just query the view. Only filter by a person when the user names someone else explicitly.
Always use the v_* views for opportunities, KPIs, accounts, calls, scores and actions. gold_user_hierarchy is the org chart, gold_lead_scores holds AI fit and routing for unassigned open leads (no owner), gold_nba_feedback holds acceptance rates per action type.
Fiscal calendar: the fiscal year starts Feb 1 (FY27 = 2026-02-01 to 2027-01-31; Nov 2026 is FY27Q4). Prefer the fiscal_quarter column (format FYyyQn) and the is_current_quarter flag over date math. "this quarter" = is_current_quarter = true; "next quarter" = the following fiscal_quarter value.
ACV = the acv column (annual contract value, USD). "Pipeline" / "open pipeline" = SUM(acv) over opportunities with is_closed = false. "Weighted" or "ACV times close probability" = acv * v_deal_scores.p_close_quarter (the AI probability, 0..1), not the CRM probability column.
"At risk" deal = open opportunity with v_deal_scores.p_close_quarter < 0.4 AND close date in the current fiscal quarter (v_opportunity_pipeline.is_current_quarter).
"Competitive" deal (or a deal that "mentions a competitor") = v_deal_scores.competitive_risk > 0.5 OR size(v_call_insights.competitors) > 0 on any of its calls. Aggregate call competitors per opportunity with array_distinct(flatten(collect_list(competitors))) to avoid duplicate rows.
Joins: opportunity_id joins v_opportunity_pipeline to v_deal_scores (1:1), v_call_insights (1 opp : many calls) and v_next_best_actions (1 opp : many actions). account_id joins accounts. owner_id joins gold_user_hierarchy.user_id.
Usage: v_account_360.usage_trend_pct_30d is the percent change in active vehicles, last 30 days vs the 30 days before; "usage down more than 15%" = usage_trend_pct_30d < -15. "Has an open opportunity" = v_account_360.open_opportunities > 0. Prospects have NULL usage.
Call next steps: v_call_insights.next_steps is ARRAY<STRUCT<action, owner, due>>. To list them, explode it: SELECT ..., ns.action, ns.owner, ns.due FROM v_call_insights c LATERAL VIEW explode(c.next_steps) t AS ns. "My last calls" = the most recent calls by started_at (e.g. the latest call per opportunity, or the last 5 calls). Ignore rows where extract_error is not null. Recommended actions with a status live in v_next_best_actions (status = 'open' for open actions; order by priority_score DESC).
Show money as USD, round probabilities to 2 decimals, and include opportunity_name and account_name when listing deals.

question: Which of my deals are at risk this quarter?
sql:
SELECT p.opportunity_id, p.opportunity_name, p.account_name, p.stage, p.acv, p.close_date,
       ROUND(s.p_close_quarter, 2) AS p_close_quarter, s.close_label, s.next_action
FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.v_opportunity_pipeline p
JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.v_deal_scores s ON s.opportunity_id = p.opportunity_id
WHERE NOT p.is_closed AND p.is_current_quarter AND s.p_close_quarter < 0.4
ORDER BY p.acv DESC
usage_guidance: Definition of an at-risk deal. Scope is already applied by the views; never filter by owner.

question: Which of my competitive deals close this quarter?
sql:
SELECT p.opportunity_id, p.opportunity_name, p.account_name, p.stage, p.acv, p.close_date,
       ROUND(s.competitive_risk, 2) AS competitive_risk,
       array_distinct(flatten(collect_list(c.competitors))) AS competitors_mentioned
FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.v_opportunity_pipeline p
LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.v_deal_scores s ON s.opportunity_id = p.opportunity_id
LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.v_call_insights c ON c.opportunity_id = p.opportunity_id
WHERE NOT p.is_closed AND p.is_current_quarter
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING s.competitive_risk > 0.5 OR size(competitors_mentioned) > 0
ORDER BY p.acv DESC
usage_guidance: Definition of a competitive deal (also: deals that mention a competitor).

question: What is my quota attainment this quarter?
sql:
SELECT owner_name, fiscal_quarter, quota, closed_won_acv, attainment_pct, open_pipeline_acv, coverage_ratio
FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.v_seller_kpis
WHERE is_current_quarter
ORDER BY owner_name
usage_guidance: Quota, attainment and coverage come from v_seller_kpis (one row per seller and fiscal quarter).
